segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמַּדִּיר הֲנָאָה מֵחֲתָנוֹ, וְהוּא רוֹצֶה לָתֵת לְבִתּוֹ מָעוֹת, אוֹמֵר לָהּ: הֲרֵי הַמָּעוֹת הָאֵלּוּ נְתוּנִין לָךְ בְּמַתָּנָה, וּבִלְבַד שֶׁלֹּא יְהֵא לְבַעְלִיךְ רְשׁוּת בָּהֶן, אֶלָּא מָה שֶׁאַתְּ נוֹשֵׂאת וְנוֹתֶנֶת בְּפִיךְ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «one who vows» that «benefit» from him is forbidden «to his son-in-law, but he» nevertheless «wishes to give his daughter,» i.e., the wife of that same son-in-law, «money,» then, though he cannot do so directly, as anything acquired by a woman belongs to her husband, «he» should «say to her: This money is hereby given to you as a gift, provided that your husband has no rights to it,» but the gift includes «only that which you pick up and place in your mouth.»

moves.summary: gift to daughter excluding husband's rights

positions.claim: he gives it on condition the husband has no rights, only what she eats
